header.name: Interaction Design Perspectives Methods
header.description: This course provides description of various design methods at the various stages of designing. Students will learn to conduct in depth user analysis, understand the nuances of questionnaire design and analyze the user data quantitatively and qualitatively. Students will also be able to create prototypes and conduct usability testing of the developed prototypes.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Understanding of each stage of HCI design process

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to conduct in-depth user analysis and establish user requirements

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to create high fidelity prototypes of HCI problems through application of various design methods and use of various tools

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to apply various usability testing methods for the evaluation of interfaces

lecture_topics: Design Methods for Requirement Identification: Habitat Study, Role Play, Questionnaire and survey
Design Methods for Requirement Identification: Focus Group Discussion, ISQ, Quality Function Deployment, Market Study
Design Methods for Requirement Identification: KANO Analysis, Statistical Analysis of User Feedback
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignment 1: Establish user requirements for a given problem

lecture_topics: Methods for Design Envisionment: Moodboards, Storyboards, Snapshots and Sketches, Navigation Maps, Low and high fidelity prototypes
Methods for Conceptual Design : Metaphors, Scenarios
Methods for Conceptual Design: Metaphors, Scenarios
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignment 2: Propose solution concepts for the problem

lecture_topics: Methods for Design Evaluation: Expert Evalution, Participant based evaluation, Evaluations in Practice, Reliability, Validation
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignment 3: Evaluation of Solution Concepts and creation of protoypyes

lecture_topics: Methods for Design Evaluation: Task Analysis, GOMS, Cognitive Workload Analysis

weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignment 4: Usability Testing of the developed prototype
